findings: 2026-11-06: drafted for Mathematics 12 Unit 4 (owner request): English and a teacher-style Roman Urdu lesson; the book's content in order with our clearly labelled teaching notes; worked examples step by step with reasons; results verified with sympy.

Book correction: The printed heading of 4.1.1 reads "Construction of First-Order and Differential Equations from Practical Situations". A word is missing after "and"; in line with Section 4.2 it means "Construction of First-Order and First-Degree Differential Equations from Practical Situations". All four examples below give first-order, first-degree equations.
Book correction: The book ends Example 2 with "This is the required first ordered differential." A word is missing; it should read "This is the required first-order differential equation."

Book correction: In part (i) the book prints V_{S} = V_{r} + V_{C} with a small r. The voltage across the resistor is V_{R} (as in the very next line), so it should read V_{S} = V_{R} + V_{C}. Also, Figure 4.1 in the book labels the switch "Swithc"; it means "Switch".
